newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Former Madagascar president returns from exile.
newsitem.headline: Former Madagascar president returns from exile.

text.p: Thousands of supporters enthusiastically welcomed former president Didier Ratsiraka on Sunday when he returned from a 19-month voluntary exile in France.

Ratsiraka, a retired admiral and father of Madagascar's 1975 socialist revolution, is to run in the presidential election scheduled for November 3. Debate is underway on a possible postponement to allow for a revision of the constitution.
The election follows the impeachment of President Albert Zafy, who defeated Ratsiraka in the 1993 election, for alleged violation of the constitution and abuse of his powers.
Radio Tsioka Vao, which supports Ratsiraka, estimated the welcoming crowd at the airport at 40,000 people.
Ratsiraka, 59, faces many rivals in the election, including three former prime ministers, National Assembly president Pastor Richard Andriamanjato, and two former ministers.
